name: Haref
title: Founder of Beth-gader
summary: Haref (also called Hareph) is a person mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah in 1 Chronicles. He is described as the father (founder) of Beth-gader, a town in Judah. He was the son of Caleb through his concubine Ephrath (Ephrat).

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Haref is mentioned as the father (founder) of Beth-gader in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah, as a descendant of Caleb and Ephrath.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's descendants through Hur
keyEvents.description: Haref is part of the broader lineage of Caleb, son of Hezron, through Hur who was Ephrath's firstborn. This lineage established several towns in Judah.

keyEvents.title: The founding of Beth-gader
keyEvents.description: Haref is regarded as the founder or patriarch of Beth-gader, a city in the territory of the tribe of Judah. This highlights his role in settling the promised land.

keyEvents.title: Part of Hur's descendants
keyEvents.description: Together with Shobal (father of Kiriath-jearim) and Salma (father of Bethlehem), Haref formed one of three branches of Hur's descendants who founded important cities in Judah.
